cutout_quality: PASS. Recipe: rembg u2net_human_seg, post_process_mask=True, no alpha matting, source sophia_headshot.jpg. Verified composited on #F5F3EF and #2E5E4E at 2x zoom: hair top and right edges clean (the warm rim on the hair crown is genuine backlighting, not background), no eaten limbs, hand and bag intact. One orange-foliage remnant in the sleeve/bag notch was removed by targeted color masking (dilated 2px), then 1px alpha erosion + 0.6px feather over the whole silhouette. isnet-general-use was tried and rejected (it deleted the bag and part of the torso).
